seo_title: Experiences | Walks, game drives and the Maasai village | Mara River Camp
seo_description: Walk the Ole Sugut Conservancy, drive the Maasai Mara by day or by spotlight, float above the plains by balloon, visit a Maasai village and end the day at the fire. Every experience at Mara River Camp, with rates.
label: Experiences
title: Days shaped by the river and the people who know it
lead: Every experience is led by someone who knows the place by heart and earns a stamp in your Exploreans Passport. Some come with every stay; others are arranged at the camp for a fee.
